steps.caption: Tabs: Today, Upcoming, Needs preparation, Past, Cancelled and Reports.
Today's meetings, and follow-ups you still owe from past ones.
Pick the type, the company and who is attending.
Date, time and place are optional; they put it on your calendar and day plan.
'Prepare the brief now' is ticked, so the brief is built straight away.
Readiness shows how complete the brief is and what is still missing.
Meeting purpose: why you're meeting and what triggered it.
The company: who they are, where they sit and their lease dates.
Scroll on: attendees, history with them, requirement, open items…
Questions to ask: what you still need to find out in the meeting.
…and risks or sensitive points to keep in mind.
Back in Meetings it is listed under Upcoming; it also appears on Today.
After the meeting, capture your notes — they are linked back to this meeting.
